summary.en: Ethiopian and Eritrean forces are conducting overnight drone and artillery strikes near Badme, wounding civilians, while Ethiopian militia clash with Somali Federalist Party supporters in Moyale, displacing about 700,000 people. The EU has allocated €550,000 emergency aid for civilians displaced by the Moyale conflict. A study reports severe disruption to regional healthcare systems and high rates of suicidal behavior among conflict-affected high schoolers. The conflict caused 2,824 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: Etiopiske og eritreiske styrker utfører nattlige drone- og artilleriangrep nær Badme, og påfører sivile skader, mens etiopisk milits kjemper mot støttespillere til Somali Federalist Party i Moyale, og fordrar omtrent 700 000 personer. EU har avsatt 550 000 € nødhjelp til sivile som er fordrevet av konflikten i Moyale. En studie rapporterer alvorlig forstyrrelse av regionale helsevesen og høye forekomster av selvmordstanker blant konfliktpåvirkede videregåendeelever. Konflikten forårsaket 2 824 dødsfall i kamper i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: Fano insurgency
background.extract: The Fano insurgency or Amhara war is an armed conflict and insurgency in the Amhara Region of Ethiopia that began in April 2023 between the Fano militia and the Ethiopian government. The conflict started after the government attempted to dissolve the Amhara Special Forces and other regional forces as part of a plan to reform and centralize the country's security apparatus, and integrate them into the federal armed forces. This move led to protests and armed resistance by local forces under Fano.
